name: Unhappiness
overview: Scripture reveals that unhappiness, including the heaviness of heart and trouble in relationships such as marriage, is met with God's steadfast presence and comforting strength. The Lord promises to go before us, never forsaking or failing us, offering peace that surpasses worldly understanding and encouragement to not be dismayed or afraid. He draws near to the brokenhearted and contrite in spirit, uplifting those weighed down by misery and sorrow. Moreover, a timely and kind word can bring gladness to a heavy heart, reminding believers of God's sustaining righteousness and help in times of distress.
